trigger: loading a quantized ggml-model-q4_0 file after upgrading llama-cpp-python
root_cause: llama.cpp changed the quantization format version; the Python wrapper's bundled llama.cpp was out of sync
real_fix: update the wrapper/submodule to match the new quantization format

trigger: passing --tensor_split as a CLI flag to the llama-cpp-python server
action: reformat the CLI flag (tried spaces, quotes, different separators)
root_cause: a bug from the Pydantic 2.0 migration broke several server CLI flags entirely
real_fix: use the TENSOR_SPLIT environment variable instead of the CLI flag

trigger: saving and reloading a LoRA adapter for sequence classification on DeBERTa
root_cause: DeBERTa's pooler layer is randomly initialized on load and is not auto-included in modules_to_save (only classifier is, by default)

trigger: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-2B for Yoruba support on Colab T4
action: proceed with Unsloth QLoRA fine-tuning as planned
root_cause: confirmed Unsloth/T4 dtype bug - BFloat16 != Half, incompatible with T4 hardware
real_fix: abandoned fine-tuning path entirely; switched to deterministic post-processing (16-term Yoruba glossary regex)

trigger: naming a helper script for a Python project
root_cause: collides with Python's own standard library inspect module, causing import errors
real_fix: never name embedded scripts after stdlib module names

trigger: adding an env: block under a GitHub Actions step
root_cause: GitHub Actions requires exactly 8 spaces for env: under a step; wrong indentation fails silently with no clear error
real_fix: match the exact 8-space indentation convention every time

action: pass direction and hops as parameter names
root_cause: the tool actually expects upstream (bool) and max_hops (int), not direction/hops
real_fix: always check the tool's actual parameter schema before assuming naming conventions

trigger: setting a branches: filter in a GitHub Actions workflow
action: assume the target branch is named main
root_cause: the actual repo used duckdb as its branch name, not main, so the filter silently never triggered
real_fix: confirm actual branch name in the specific repo before writing the filter
